input_fields.name: body_reference
input_fields.description: One current body whose kernel surface area is requested.

result_fields.name: surface_area_record
result_fields.description: Measured surface area, unit, body identity, and provenance.

procedure: Resolve one current body and validate the requested area unit.
Read the kernel surface area once and preserve the measured value/provenance.
Return surface_area_record and measurement_status; do not substitute a value from a face or screenshot.
Leave topology and document state unchanged.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous/invalid body, incompatible unit, or nonfinite area.
Reject a face area sum when the declared target is the body's kernel area.
Do not repair geometry inside this measurement atom.
